text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober completely loses<n>herself in her
running and comes in<n>first. However, being
exposed to Air<n>Groove's intimidating presence still
makes her shake with fear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She can't help but feel frustrated,<n>recognizing
she's still far from<n>becoming like Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Immediately after returning to the<n>waiting room, she
declares she wants<n>to race in the Takarazuka Kinen
and<n>become like Air Groove. Her<n>desperation
triggers a sense of<n>unease in me again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't put how I feel into<n>words, so we
simply set the<n>Takarazuka Kinen as her next goal.
